import unittest

from boltons.setutils import IndexedSet


class IndexedSetSliceRegressionTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.indexed = IndexedSet(range(20))
        self.indexed.remove(5)
        self.contents = list(self.indexed)

    def test_post_removal_slice_bounds_use_apparent_indices(self):
        for index in (
                slice(4, 8),
                slice(-8, -3),
                slice(None, 8),
                slice(8, None)):
            with self.subTest(index=index):
                result = self.indexed[index]
                self.assertIsInstance(result, IndexedSet)
                self.assertEqual(list(result), self.contents[index])

    def test_negative_steps_keep_reverse_then_slice_semantics(self):
        for index in (
                slice(None, None, -1),
                slice(2, 7, -1),
                slice(-7, -2, -2)):
            with self.subTest(index=index):
                expected = self.contents[::-1][
                    index.start:index.stop:-index.step]
                self.assertEqual(list(self.indexed[index]), expected)

    def test_positive_steps_agree_with_list_slicing(self):
        for index in (
                slice(None, None, 2),
                slice(3, 15, 3),
                slice(-15, -2, 2),
                slice(-100, 100, 4)):
            with self.subTest(index=index):
                result = self.indexed[index]
                self.assertIsInstance(result, IndexedSet)
                self.assertEqual(list(result), self.contents[index])


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
